name: Bash
description: Run a bash command. Supports long-running processes, interactive sessions, and environment variables.

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for the command to finish

restart.description: Restart the command if it's already running

name: Read
description: Read a file from the local filesystem. Supports line range reading for efficiency.

file_path.description: Path to the file to read

start_line.description: 1-based line number to start reading from

end_line.description: 1-based line number to end reading at

name: Write
description: Write or overwrite a file on the local filesystem.

file_path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

name: Glob
description: Find files matching specific glob patterns.

name: Grep
description: Search for a regular expression pattern within file contents.

name: Skill
description: Load a specific skill from the available skills library.

skill.description: Name of the skill to load

name: Task
description: Create a new sub-task for specialized agents or for complex planning.

objective.description: Detailed description of the task objective
